annotations.title: France income tax calculator (impôt sur le revenu)

description: Computes French personal income tax (impôt sur le revenu, IR) for a tax household: number of tax shares (parts, quotient familial), gross tax on the official DGFiP progressive scale, family-quotient cap, décote, net tax payable, average rate and marginal rate (TMI). Income years 2024, 2025. Input: household net taxable income, or declared salaries (the 10% deduction is applied). Use when a user asks how much French income tax a household pays, its marginal tax bracket (TMI), its number of tax shares, or the effect of marriage or children on the tax. Deterministic code, no LLM, exact decimal arithmetic. Matches all 7,095 values of the official DGFiP tax tables (brochure pratique 2025 and 2026) to the euro, and 15 cases checked on the official impots.gouv.fr simulator. Not supported (refused for free with HTTP 422): non-residents, overseas departments, alternating-custody children, extra half-shares (disability, veterans, box L), exceptional income taxed with the quotient system, tax credits and reductions, incomes above the high-income contribution thresholds (CEHR/CDHR). Price: 0.005 USDC per successful call, paid with x402 over MCP. Missing or invalid fields are reported for free with the questions to ask the user; you never pay for an error. Returns JSON (also in structuredContent): calculateur, resultat, detail (step by step), hypotheses, bareme (version, effective date, sources), estimation_indicative, avertissement, lien_verification. Full output schema and a real example: list_france_calculators.

annee_revenus.description: Income year (année des revenus), e.g. 2025 for the return filed in 2026. Supported: 2024, 2025.

cas_particuliers.description: Required. Special situations that apply, or [] if none: enfant_residence_alternee (alternating custody), invalidite_ou_ancien_combattant (disability or veteran card), personne_invalide_a_charge (disabled dependant), case_L (lived alone and raised a child alone 5+ years), enfant_majeur_marie_ou_charge_de_famille (attached married adult child), deces_conjoint_dans_annee (spouse died during the year), domicile_outre_mer (overseas department), non_resident, revenus_exceptionnels_ou_differes (exceptional or deferred income). Any listed situation is refused for free (HTTP 422).

enfants_a_charge.description: Number of dependent children fully or mainly in the household (minors, or adult children attached to the tax household). Do not count alternating-custody children.

nombre_declarants_65_ans_ou_plus.description: Required with salaires_declares: number of filers aged 65 or over on 31 December of the income year (0, 1 or 2), for the elderly allowance.

nombre_parts_declare.description: Optional cross-check: number of tax shares shown on the tax return or notice. If it differs from the computed number, the request is refused for free (HTTP 422).

parent_isole.description: Required if single or divorced with at least one child: true if the parent lives alone with the children, without a partner (box T, parent isolé).

revenu_net_imposable.description: Household net taxable income in EUR (revenu net imposable, after all allowances, as shown on the tax notice). Give either this field or salaires_declares.

salaires_declares.description: Alternative to revenu_net_imposable: net taxable salaries declared by each filer in EUR, before the 10% standard deduction (one value, or two for a married/PACS couple). Salaries only; for other income use revenu_net_imposable.

situation_familiale.description: Marital status on 31 December of the income year: celibataire (single), divorce_separe (divorced or separated), marie_pacse (married or civil partnership, joint return), veuf (widowed).
